3 Michelin Star Valentine's Day Dessert (at home) Chocolate Lava Cakes (Jean-Georges Inspired) Ingredients (2 cakes) 	•	¼ cup unsalted butter, cut into cubes 	•	2 oz (about ½ cup) semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips/chunks 	•	1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk 	•	2 tbsp sugar 	•	1 tsp flour, plus extra for dusting 	•	Butter for greasing ramekins Steps 	1.	Heat oven to 450°F (230°C). 	2.	Butter two 4-oz ramekins, dust with flour, and tap out excess. 	3.	Melt chocolate (microwave or double boiler). Stir in butter until smooth. 	4.	In a separate bowl, whisk egg, yolk, and sugar until pale. 	5.	Stir egg mixture into melted chocolate, add flour, and whisk to combine. 	6.	Divide batter between ramekins. Place on a baking sheet. 	7.	Bake 6–8 min until tops are set but centers still jiggle. 	8.	Invert onto plates, gently lift ramekins, and serve immediately (ice cream optional).

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Pon a pre-calentar el horno a 425 Fahrenheit.  2. En un bowl, agrega los chocolate chips y la mantequilla, y calienta en el microondas en intérvalos de 20 segundos hasta que se derrita completo. Engrasa el ramekin con mantequilla y espolvorea una capa fina de cocoa.  6. Vierte la mezcla hasta la mitad del ramekin, coloca el cubito de chocolate en el centro y termina de servir la mezcla. 7. 🍫 Chocolate Molten Lava Cake Ingredients * ½ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips * ⅓ cup butter * 2 eggs * 2 egg yolks * ¼ cup sugar * ¼ cup all-purpose flour * Butter, for greasing ramekins * Cocoa powder, for dusting * Powdered sugar, for garnish Instructions 1. Prepare the ramekins: Preheat your oven to 425°F. Generously butter the inside of the ramekins, then dust with cocoa powder, shaking out any excess. 2. Melt the chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and butter. Microwave in 30-second increments, stirring well after each, until completely melted and smooth. Set aside. 3. Mix the eggs: In a separate bowl, add the eggs, egg yolks, and sugar. Beat for about 2 minutes, until the mixture becomes lighter and slightly thickened. 4. Combine: Add the flour and melted chocolate mixture to the egg mixture. Mix until everything is completely combined and smooth. 5. Fill the ramekins: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 6. Bake: Place in the preheated oven and bake for 12–13 minutes. The edges should be set while the center remains soft. 7. Rest and remove: Let the cakes sit for 1–2 minutes after removing them from the oven. Carefully loosen the edges with a knife if needed, then invert onto a serving plate. 8. Serve: Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately while the center is warm and gooey. 🍫✨#fyp #viral #fypシ #cake #chocolate

🍫 GÂTEAU VOLCAN  Dimensions du moule ➡️Env. 22 × 18 cm  Ingrédients ➤ Gâteau 	•	3 œufs 	•	170 g d’huile neutre 	•	100g de sucre 	•	75 g de cacao non sucré 	•	240 g d’eau chaude 	•	180 g de farine 	•	15 g de levure chimique 	•	1 c. café rase de bicarbonate ➤ Sirop chocolat 	•	480 g de lait 	•	120 g de cacao 	•	30 g de beurre ➤ Ganache 	•	200 g de chocolat (noir, lait ou mix) 	•	200 g de crème liquide Étapes : Préchauffe ton four à 180°C chaleur tournante. Dans un grand bol, fouette ensemble les œufs, le sucre, l’huile, le cacao et l’eau chaude jusqu’à obtenir une pâte lisse. Ajoute la farine, la levure et le bicarbonate et mélange juste assez pour que la pâte soit homogène. Verse dans un moule beurré ou huilé d’environ 22 × 18 cm et enfourne 25 minutes, en surveillant dès 20 minutes : le centre doit rester tremblotant. Pendant la cuisson, prépare le sirop chocolat en chauffant le lait, le sucre, le cacao et le beurre jusqu’aux premiers frémissements puis coupe le feu. Dès que le gâteau sort du four, verse tout le sirop dessus et laisse absorber 10 à 15 minutes. Fais chauffer la crème, verse-la sur le chocolat, laisse fondre puis mélange et nappe le dessus. Sers tiède, à la cuillère, texture volcan garantie 😍🍫

Cokelat pekat dan mint segar berpadu dalam mousse gunung meletus yang mewah tanpa oven. Bahan simpel, hasil elegan—cocok buat ide frozen dessert atau camilan cantik di rumah. Simak resepnya dan tag sahabatmu yang wajib cobain juga! 🍫 --- Volcano Mint Choco Mousse Cake ❄️🌋 (Kue Mousse Cokelat Mint Gunung Meletus Beku) 🍰 Bahan A – Mousse Cokelat Mint Cream cheese: 250 gram Gula pasir halus: 30 gram Whipping cream cair (bisa pakai merek Anchor/Elle & Vire): 150 ml Gelatin bubuk: 10 gram (rendam dulu dengan 3 sdm air dingin, biarkan mengembang) Susu UHT hangat: 80 ml Cokelat chip atau dark compound chocolate cincang: 40 gram Sirup mint (bisa pakai sirup daun mint botolan atau pasta mint): 50 ml 🍫 Bahan B – Dekorasi Whipping cream cair: 30 ml Dark chocolate: 20 gram Ceri segar atau kalengan: 4 buah --- 👩‍🍳 Langkah Pembuatan: 1. Campurkan cream cheese dan gula pasir dalam mangkuk, aduk menggunakan whisk atau mixer kecepatan rendah hingga lembut dan halus. Tambahkan whipping cream, aduk hingga tercampur rata. 2. Panaskan susu hangat, lalu masukkan gelatin yang sudah direndam, aduk hingga larut sempurna. Tambahkan cokelat dan sirup mint, aduk rata hingga cokelat mencair. 3. Tuang campuran gelatin ke adonan cream cheese, aduk rata perlahan hingga semua tercampur halus. Tuang ke dalam cetakan silikon berbentuk bulat atau setengah bola. Simpan dalam freezer selama 6 jam atau hingga benar-benar beku. 4. Ganache: Lelehkan dark chocolate dan whipping cream secara terpisah di microwave selama 30 detik, lalu campurkan keduanya dan aduk hingga mengkilap. 5. Keluarkan mousse dari cetakan, tuang ganache hangat di atasnya untuk efek meleleh seperti gunung berapi, lalu hias dengan ceri di atasnya. These were out of this world 🤤 Soulistic Lava Cakes Ingredients 	•	60g unsalted butter 	•	85g dark chocolate 	•	55g coconut sugar 	•	1 large egg 	•	1 large egg yolk (room temperature) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract 	•	1 tbsp Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	•	2 tsp plain flour 	•	Pinch sea salt To serve (optional): 	•	Dusting of Soulistic  Method 1. Preheat your oven to 220°C (200°C fan-forced). Generously grease and lightly dust two 180ml ramekins (or three 120ml ramekins) with Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	 2. Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat on stove consistently stirring between, until smooth. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut sugar, egg, egg yolk and vanilla until slightly fluffy (an electric hand mixer works best). 4. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture and stir until combined. 5. Gently fold through the Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao, flour and salt until just combined. 6. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 7. Bake for 10–11 minutes (for 180ml ramekins) or 7–8 minutes (for 120ml ramekins). The edges should be set while the centre remains slightly wobbly. 8. Let the cakes rest for 2–3 minutes, then carefully invert onto serving plates. 9. Serve immediately with a dusting of Soulistic and enjoy!
